role_evidence.quote: ASTEROID: A Trial of ASTX660 in Combination With Pembrolizumab

This is a multi-centre Phase I dose finding and proof-of-concept study of the combination of ASTX660 together with Pembrolizumab with expansion cohorts testing preliminary efficacy in immune-refractory cancers, triple negative breast cancer (TNBC), cervical cancer, and glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Multi-cancer basket; GBM is eligible only in Part B4 (relapsed GBM, WHO CNS5 2021, IDH-wildtype), which the record says is no longer recruiting; GBM cohort is not listed in the Part B arm label (only B1-B3). GBM diagnostic molecular features (TERT promoter mutation, EGFR amplification, chr7 gain/10 loss) are alternative diagnostic criteria, not selection requirements, so not recorded as separate biomarker rows. PD-L1 positivity is required only for the cervical cancer cohort B2. Part A requires fresh paired biopsies for biomarker analysis. ASTX660 PK is plasma only.
